statement: How should a public rating be reported when a held or unreviewed finding sets that rating?

Held and unreviewed findings count in synthesis. Publish the rating and label it provisional when a confirmed rating setter is held or unreviewed. If setter coverage is incomplete and no unresolved setter is confirmed, report the status as undetermined.
The edition status builder records unresolved setter IDs and distinguishes provisional, assessed clear and undetermined. Its held-setter replay retains the finding and rating.
Separate knowledge basis from extraction format and document source dependence and literature-derived expert judgement.

Add independent knowledge_basis and extraction_format fields. Preserve legacy claim_basis and historical analytical reproduction. Migrate table/figure labels to unknown knowledge basis without inferring measurement. New claims require independently stated basis and format. Do not infer independence from row counts or authorship. Expert opinion is derived from literature; no direct elicitation is in scope. Numerical weighting changes require a separate scientific release.
